summary: The fund is an actively managed non-diversified ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in asset classes that Draco Evolution Corp., the fund’s sub-adviser believes offer the most attractive combined risk/return opportunities. The term “asset classes” generally includes, among others, U.S. equities of small-, mid- and large- capitalization companies, gold, fixed-income securities etc. The fund is non-diversified.
